meta.label: measured on simulated devices with fictional data; attacks written by the team

attacks.name: Eavesdrop on a delivery
attacks.wins: Captured frames reveal the trip, the floor or a private marker

attacks.name: Inject a lift call from outside
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call

attacks.name: Replay a recorded lift call a minute later
attacks.wins: The lift receives a second call

attacks.name: Change the floor in transit
attacks.wins: The lift is called for a floor the robot did not ask for

attacks.name: One robot pretends to be another
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call in RX-01's name

attacks.name: A robot calls the lift with no delivery of its own
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call

attacks.name: Compromised fleet manager invents a lift call
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call

attacks.name: Genuine robot asks for the wrong floor
attacks.wins: The lift is called for L1 on a trip to L2

attacks.name: A retired robot keeps working
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call

attacks.name: Steal a credential off the wire and use it elsewhere
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call triggered by the attacker's device

attacks.name: Hold a lift call for two minutes, then release it
attacks.wins: The lift receives the stale call

attacks.name: Forge or replay the adapter's reply
attacks.wins: The robot believes a refused call was allowed

attacks.name: Impersonate the lift adapter
attacks.wins: The robot accepts an answer from the attacker

attacks.name: Flood from one compromised robot
attacks.wins: Fewer than 90% of other robots' legitimate calls are served

attacks.name: Decrypt recorded traffic with keys stolen later
attacks.wins: The recorded lift calls can be read

attacks.name: Rewrite or cut the audit log and repair its hashes
attacks.wins: Verification still passes

attacks.name: Over-sharing
attacks.wins: A private marker reaches the lift-side log

attacks.name: Suppress lift status updates
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call while the adapter's status is older than 10 seconds

attacks.name: Robot calls the lift when it is not at the lift
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call

attacks.name: Compromised dispatcher issues a wrong grant
attacks.wins: The lift is called for the wrong floor

attacks.name: Traffic analysis
attacks.wins: The attacker can tell when a robot called the lift

attacks.name: Lock out a genuine robot by abusing the breaker
attacks.wins: RX-01's next legitimate call, two minutes later, is refused

attacks.name: Compromised fleet manager reads the deliveries it relays
attacks.wins: The fleet manager sees the trip and the floor

attacks.name: Flood the lift adapter directly, past the fleet manager
attacks.wins: Fewer than 90% of other robots' legitimate calls are served

attacks.name: Compromised fleet manager reroutes a robot
attacks.wins: The robot accepts a mission the hospital did not order

attacks.name: Compromised fleet manager takes the lift hostage
attacks.wins: The lift receives 10 or more calls nobody ordered

attacks.name: Compromised fleet manager stops relaying
attacks.wins: Robots can no longer call the lift

attacks.name: Flood the lift adapter from the wired path, posing as the relay
attacks.wins: Fewer than 90% of other robots' legitimate calls are served

attacks.name: A replaced fleet manager keeps using its old credentials
attacks.wins: The lift receives a call

legit.name: Held for a patient transfer, robot keeps retrying
Recovery: the fleet manager's credentials are revoked and replaced
The robot accepts the hospital's own mission
Three robots call at the same moment, five times over
